in_sanskrit.name: कूहु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: प्रसन्नता (prasannatā) - pleasing to the mind, अम्विध (amvida) - to behold, विध (vidh) - to make, सू (sū) - good, हु (hu) - to become. Thus, Kuhu means 'becoming pleasing to the mind' or 'delightful'.

in_hindi.name: कूहू
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रसन्नता (prasannatā) - pleasing, पूर्ण (pūrṇa) - full. Thus, Kuhu in Hindi means 'full of pleasure' or 'delightful'.

in_tamil.name: குஹு
in_tamil.long_meaning: குறியிடம் (kuṟiyiḍam) - pleasing, ஆரம்பிக்கும் (ārambikum) - initiating, creating, or causing. Thus, Kuhu in Tamil means 'initiating pleasure' or 'delightful'.

in_marathi.name: Kuhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kuhu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ku’, which means ‘Moon’. The name Kuhu symbolizes the gentle and soft light of the moon. This name is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her compassionate nature.
